gaps.name: rug: no patterned library surface
gaps.reason: The rug is a flat-sheet code build (score/stages/props/flat_sheet.py) finished with the library surface rug_pile, a plain tan pile, while its close-up shows a strongly patterned medallion rug; its outline passes (0.881) but DINOv2 likeness cannot reach 0.14 with any surface the library holds, so a retake would fail the same way (checkout 71, 2026-11-09). A patterned rug surface scores 0.35-0.37 locally but moves about 47 paid rows across every place (the recipes file and library folders key every surfaces-bake, surface-tiles and people-dress row), so it lands after the demo, batched with the flat_sheet drop-shadow cut fix and a narrower keying of the bake and dress rows.
gaps.decided: the owner's rule of 2026-11-09 ("EVERY FAIL GETS ONE PAID RETAKE, IF FAIL AGAIN, GAP"), applied by the score session for this try and the demo, 2026-11-09 ~18:30 UTC
